name: North Star Seal (Bắc Thần Ấn)
lore: A square seal of grey river stone from under Thạch Kiều's first bridge, cut with the seven stars and the pole. Chung Hoài Cực stamped the North Star Compact with it in 510 (C107), and every writ of war since bears its mark. Legendary item bac_than_an.
build_use: The head's array-and-seal build: heavier, longer Earth stacks, and the foe's buffs shut out.

name: Seven-Star Array Flag (Thất Tinh Trận Kỳ)
lore: Black silk on an iron staff, sewn with seven silver stars that move a little through the year. The founder planted it on the day the seat was raised (C002), and the seat's Seven-Star Array is still keyed to it.
build_use: Array keeper's anchor: Earth buffs held longer, wards doubled on the turn.

name: Weight of the Heavenly Balance (Thiên Quyền Thạch)
lore: The first standard weight of Thiên Quyền Thị's scales (A207), a black stone the size of a fist that weighs the same in every season. Chung Hoài Cực gave it to the first Chief Judge, Hề Văn Ước, with one rule: the one who seals does not weigh. The Chief Judge holds it.
build_use: The judge's seal build: curses and Earth stacks that last, and costly arts for the weighed.

lore: Grey, unembroidered, with the bridge's seven arches woven into the hem in the same grey. Every Chief Judge has worn it since 510; the cuffs are darker where two judges' wrists have rested on the bench for seven centuries.

name: Army-Breaker Spear (Phá Quân Thương)
lore: Hạ Lang Tinh's spear, forged in 760 for the founder of Phá Quân Môn and taken from his hand when the rebel gate fell in 874 (C163). Đỗ Tinh Hà has carried it ever since and has never had the rebel's star filed off the blade.
build_use: The patient spearman: one called blow that crits and pierces.

name: War Drum of the Seventh Star (Dao Quang Chiến Cổ)
lore: An iron-hooped drum skinned with the hide of a mountain ox from Mao Ngưu Thôn. The Dao Quang Hall beat it to muster in the Pirate Purge and at Cố Lũy; it has not been struck in earnest since 805, and Ngũ Trấn Bắc has it tuned every spring.
build_use: A war-array build: summoned wardens and formation links that hit together.

name: Envoy's Jade Tally (Sứ Tiết Ngọc Phù)
lore: A white jade half-tally; the other half is kept in Tàng Ước Các. The Pivot cut its envoys' tallies in jade, not iron, after its envoy Trình Bạch Tiết was killed at Phá Quân Môn in 870 (N-thien_xu-06): an envoy of the Pivot carries nothing that can be mistaken for a weapon.
build_use: An envoy's guard: soul resistance, a softened first blow, a way out.

name: Inkstone of the Compact (Bắc Thần Nghiễn)
lore: The inkstone the Compact's text was ground on in 510, a slab of black Chấp Bút Phong slate worn into a hollow. Every keeper of Tàng Ước Các has ground the ink for the archive's copies on it. Sử Ngưng Mặc says the hollow is two fingers deeper than when she was given it.
build_use: An archivist's seal build: long curses, steady linh lực.

lore: A narrow, perfectly straight blade that hangs point-down when it is not flying, like a mason's plumb. The head gave it to his chief disciple at his Kết Đan in 1112 with the words: a straight line needs no witness.

name: Assayer's Touchstone (Thí Kim Thạch)
lore: A black jasper pendant scored with a thousand streaks of gold and silver: every coin struck at Bạch Ngân since 450 (A224) has been rubbed on it once. The Ngọc Hành Hall's master wears it at the throat.
build_use: A steward's piece: thần thức, linh lực, and an eye no merchant can cheat.

name: Square-and-Compass Flag (Quy Củ Kỳ)
lore: A small square flag on a staff made from a carpenter's square and a compass bound together. The Thiên Cơ Hall's master plants it first whenever a stele is set; it was made for the stele walk of 515.
build_use: A Stele-charge build: anchors that hold and Earth wards that last.

name: Copyist's Seal (Sao Lục Ấn)
lore: The small soapstone seal every copyist of Tàng Ước Các presses at the foot of a copy, so that any page can be traced to its hand. Thích Minh Thư's is cut with a pine-soot sprig for her village. She did not press it on the copy she gave away, and the archive will know her hand without it.
build_use: A copyist's first seal: thần thức and steady linh lực.

name: Armoured Horse Banner (Thiết Mã Kỳ)
lore: The marshal's banner, black silk woven with black iron thread from Huyền Thiết, which drinks light and is why the pair is Darkness. Đỗ Tinh Hà gave it to Quý Trường Kích in 785 (C154). Lôi Vô Danh carried it off the plain of Chiết Kích in 803 and hid it with himself in the cave abode of slot A-3 on Thiên Tuyền Nguyên, where he died in 950. Element Darkness (am). Legendary item thiet_ma_ky.
build_use: A summoner's war standard; whole only with its tally.
where: cave abode A-3, Thiên Tuyền Nguyên (lost)

name: Armoured Horse Tally (Thiết Mã Phù)
lore: A black iron tally in the shape of a horse, split down the spine; the halves fit only each other. Whoever holds it commands the army that waits in the realm of Thiết Mã Cảnh. It was lost the day Quý Trường Kích fell (C017): the half he carried is in the realm, and the half kept at the seat went missing from Tàng Ước Các the same year. Element Darkness (am). Legendary item thiet_ma_phu. No tally base exists in design/items; base null until one does.
build_use: The command half of the Thiết Mã pair.
